problem: Transfer demonstrations between arms/end-effectors with different morphology while preserving task-relevant interaction geometry.
contribution: CEI defines functional surface point/normal sets, aligns their trajectories with Directional Chamfer Distance and synthesizes target proprioception and point-cloud observations for policy learning.
algorithm: Transform finger-pad surface points/normals through FK; optimize target joint slices sequentially for geometric/directional similarity. Generate next-joint-position actions, remove source-robot cloud points and add sampled target meshes, then downsample to1024points for training/inference consistency.
observations: Measured proprioception, calibrated point clouds and source/target geometry. Mesh contact similarity does not observe tactile force or stable object ownership.
actions: Target next-joint positions with closed-loop execution until the measured configuration reaches the target; this feedback assumption is stronger than sending an unverified command estimate.
embodiment_and_data: Three simulation tasks across16arm/end-effector combinations; real AG95↔Xhand transfers over6tasks,25source demonstrations per task direction subset and10evaluation trials/task.
experiments: Geometry replay, learned-policy augmentation ablations, bidirectional physical transfer and spatial/multimodal synthesis. Dataset duplication is used for timing measurements and does not create independent demonstrations.
baselines: Binary manual specification, no/inference-augmentation removals and synthesis-time comparisons with MimicGen/DemoGen. MimicGen timing includes an estimated20smanual reset and is not a measured identical execution pipeline.

quantitative_result.value: Real TableV target successes42/60=70%; source51/60=85%; reported transfer ratio82.4% is target/source, not an82.4%absolute task success rate. InsertFlower target2/10 versus source4/10 exposes slip/contact limitations.
quantitative_result.location: PDF p6 TableV and ratio definition; p7 TableVI timing protocol

limitations: Visual/kinematic geometry cannot detect unstable contact reliably; source explicitly motivates tactile feedback. Contact-rich stacking degrades sharply. Current validated interface is point-cloud based; RGB extension and large-scale use remain future/preliminary.
code_and_license: Primary algorithm, tables and assumptions read; source implementation, TorchSDF/dependency licenses and execution were not audited. No CEI reproduction is claimed.
hardware_adaptation: A strong comparison for geometry-based transfer after measured joint feedback, calibrated clouds and gripper functional surfaces exist. Explorer's URDF FK/object-relative IK is simpler engineering glue and must not be presented as this full policy/data-synthesis algorithm.

evidence_locations.supports: Raw counts and normalized transfer ratio
Duplicated timing datasets and estimated reset
